A line item of a Shopify order, for one SKU.

Amazon order

Amazon order line
A line of an Amazon order, for one SKU.
FBA shipment

3PL outbound line
A line shipped out by the 3PL warehouse, part of a Shopify order or an FBA shipment.
3PL receipt
A goods receipt at the 3PL warehouse, optionally against a purchase order.
3PL receipt line
A line of a 3PL receipt, for one SKU.
SKU
A product we sell, with its codes in each system; some also carry Amazon identifiers.
Supplier
A factory or vendor we buy goods from.
Purchase order
An order we place with a supplier for goods.
Purchase order line
A line of a purchase order: a quantity of one SKU at a unit price.
Shipment
A freight shipment of goods, by sea or air, from origin to destination.
Shipment line
A line of a shipment: quantity and cartons of one purchase order line.
QC inspection

Customs entry

Document
